summary: KAN-92 branch closes the remaining gaps for profile image upload: Header/Sidebar now bind User.avatar (fixing broken avatarUrl references on main), avatar removal persists via 'avatar' in input merge in user.service.ts and previewUrl() ?? undefined in profile-form, and avatar-section CSS is added. Together with existing upload/validation/preview logic on the branch, all eight ACs are satisfied. Minor gaps: no sidebar avatar spec, MIME-only validation, npm test blocked by Node v20 in review env.

gaps: Success feedback appears on profile save (profile.component.ts:64-68), not immediately on file pick; aligns with save-to-persist workflow but is indirect for 'upload actions' AC wording.
Mobile/desktop AC has no explicit responsive or viewport test coverage.
evidence: profile-form.component.ts:36-48 file input accept .jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp and Change Image control.
profile-form.component.ts:464-472 MIME validation and 2MB cap with avatarError role=alert.
profile-form.component.ts:482-484 removeImage() clears preview; onSubmit passes avatar: previewUrl() ?? undefined.
header.component.html:72-73 and sidebar.component.html:10-11 bind profileUser()?.avatar (diff).
profile.component.html:29-30 displays user.avatar on Profile page.
user.service.ts:684-689 persistUsers writes users (including avatar) to localStorage.

gaps: File input value is not reset after selection; re-selecting the same file may not fire change (profile-form.component.ts:457-479).
evidence: user.service.ts:218 avatar: 'avatar' in input ? input.avatar : existing.avatar allows explicit undefined to clear avatar.
profile-form.component.ts:513 ?? operator ensures null previewUrl becomes undefined (not skipped like || on main).
profile-form.component.ts:475-478 FileReader sets previewUrl immediately on valid upload.
profile.service.ts:63,90 passes input.avatar through to UserService create/update.

gaps: Large base64 avatars stored in localStorage may inflate app.users payload; no server-side size guard beyond client 2MB check.
evidence: Diff touches 9 files: user.service, profile-form, header, sidebar (+ specs/CSS).
Header initials fallback unchanged when avatar absent (header.component.html:74-76).
Property rename avatarUrl→avatar aligns with user.model.ts:14.

gaps: No sidebar.component.spec.ts asserting img.sidebar-avatar when user.avatar is set.
No integration test simulating page refresh / localStorage reload for avatar persistence.
npm test failed in review environment: Node v20.19.2 below Angular CLI minimum v22.22.3.
evidence: profile-form.component.spec.ts:108-139 covers valid upload, invalid format, oversized file.
profile-form.component.spec.ts:165-185 clears avatar when removed and form saved.
user.service.spec.ts:104-120 clears avatar when explicitly removed.
header.component.spec.ts:138-153 renders img.avatar-img when user.avatar set.

gaps: Avatar upload UI styles live in profile-form inline styles block rather than a shared stylesheet (acceptable for scoped component).
evidence: profile-form.component.ts:317-405 adds profile-avatar-section, avatar-container, sr-only styles (+92 lines in diff).
header.component.css:133-138 .avatar-img object-fit:cover; sidebar.component.css:46-51 .sidebar-avatar sizing.
Consistent avatar property naming across layout templates and User model.

gaps: Validation relies on file.type MIME only; extension spoofing possible (profile-form.component.ts:464-467).
Data URLs stored in localStorage without sanitization beyond client-side type check.
evidence: No external upload endpoint; avatar stored as data URL via UserService.persistUsers.
accept attribute restricts file picker to image extensions (profile-form.component.ts:41).

gaps: 2MB limit and supported formats documented only in inline error strings, not README or shared constants.
evidence: profile.component.ts success banner covers save feedback.
avatarError role=alert provides accessible error feedback (profile-form.component.ts:51-52).

findings.title: No sidebar avatar rendering test
findings.detail: Header spec covers img.avatar-img when avatar is set; sidebar template changed to profileUser()?.avatar but has no equivalent spec.

findings.title: MIME-only file type validation
findings.detail: allowedTypes checks file.type only; a renamed non-image file with spoofed MIME could pass client validation.

findings.title: No refresh-persistence integration test
findings.detail: Avatar persistence relies on UserService localStorage round-trip; no spec reloads storage to verify post-refresh display.

checklist: All eight KAN-92 ACs addressed: upload, update/remove, format validation, error messages, immediate preview, localStorage persistence, Header/Sidebar/Profile display, responsive CSS.
Prior main blockers fixed: avatarUrl→avatar, avatar removal merge logic, missing avatar-section CSS.
Run npm test on Node >=22.22.3 in CI to confirm full suite passes.
Optional: add sidebar.component.spec.ts avatar image assertion mirroring header test.
